latestTerminalSummary:
Completed the investigator stage under the single native Goal. The activation guard passed, and the terminal capture reports `complete` with `terminal_capture_checked=true`. Elapsed Goal time: 18m 28s.

The draft includes dispositions for all 18 released-plan clauses, a state model, alternatives, ownership boundaries, and a proposed validation matrix. It separates client feedback from server authority, uses version checks for concurrent writes, and preserves drafts through errors and uncertain saves. Research covers WCAG 2.2, conditional HTTP writes, GOV.UK’s error-summary pattern, and USWDS’s documented findings on live validation checklists. ([WCAG 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/2024/REC-WCAG22-20241212/), [RFC 9110](https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9110.html), [USWDS validation guidance](https://designsystem.digital.gov/components/validation/))

- [Source map](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P01-control/run/D-R1-P01-control/stages/investigator/source-map.json>) and [source index](<ER13_RUNTIME/mechanics/dispatch-v1/admitted/D-R1-P01-control/run/D-R1-P01-control/stages/investigator/sources/index.md>)
